_meta.description: Flagged irregularities and unverified items. Published on the Flagged for Review page. None of these block the merge (per the user's instruction). 'Needs review' means the user should decide.

flags.title: Category commission rate unverified (blank on all rows)
flags.detail: The official Standard Commission Income schedule is behind an Amazon sign-in. Third-party sites disagree (Kitchen is listed at 4.5% by one and 5% by another), so no rate was entered. Earnings and commission potential cannot be calculated until the rate is read from the schedule in an authenticated Associates account.
flags.action: Sign in to Associates Central, read the rate for the category Amazon assigns to these products, and send it for entry.

flags.title: Prices and star ratings withheld from the public site
flags.detail: Participation Requirements Section 2(b) allows prices and availability to be shown only if Amazon serves the link or the data comes from Creators API / PA API. Section 3(t) bars star ratings and review data unless obtained the same way. The verification read prices and ratings, but they are not published. The pricing and rating analysis the brief asks for therefore cannot be shown on a static site.
flags.action: Decide whether to (a) apply for PA-API / Creators API access, which requires review of its license terms (not reviewed in this pass), or (b) accept price and rating fields as withheld.

flags.title: Associates tag not visible in the resolved links
flags.detail: All three short links resolve to Amazon product URLs (checked 2026-11-14). The resolved URLs carry tracking parameters (for example btn_ref=srctok-..., channelId=704) but no 'tag=' parameter. Commission attribution to the user's Associates ID therefore cannot be confirmed from the page.
flags.action: Confirm in Associates Central that each link was generated under the user's Associates ID. Send the tagged canonical URL if the short links do not carry the tag.

flags.title: Short-link codes do not match the ASINs they resolve to
flags.detail: The codes B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3 and B00hJ57DV are not ASINs. Checked 2026-11-14: they resolve to B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R and B08DKYBTPH (the last with variation parameter th=1). The ASIN from the resolved URL is used everywhere on the site.
flags.action: Confirm each resolved ASIN is the intended product.

flags.title: Brand for P2 is ambiguous
flags.detail: The Emeril product page lists 'Visit the Emeril Store' and shows the byline 'Innovation IQ'. The brand is therefore left unresolved rather than assumed to be Emeril Lagasse.
flags.action: Confirm the brand/manufacturer from the product's 'Product information' section or the seller page.

flags.title: Capacity units differ between title and specification
flags.detail: P1 title says '6 Quart' but the specification says '6 liters'. P2 title says '26QT' but the specification says '24.6 liters'. Units were not converted, so the two values were left exactly as listed.
flags.action: Confirm the capacity the manufacturer states (quarts or liters) before using it in comparisons.

flags.title: Colour differs between title and specification (P1)
flags.detail: The title ends in 'Black'; the specification table lists 'Black, Gray'.
flags.action: Confirm the colour option the user intends to promote.

flags.title: P3 is a size-variant family
flags.detail: The P3 page offers size options of 6, 8 and 9 quarts. The short link resolves to the 8-quart variant (ASIN B08DKYBTPH, with variation parameter th=1). Capacity values on the site are for the 8-quart variant only.
flags.action: Confirm whether the user wants the 8-quart variant or the family.

flags.title: Associates marketplace and delivery location not recorded
flags.detail: The product pages were read with a US delivery location set (the page shows 'Delivering to Fairfax 22030'). The repository does not record which Associates marketplace the links were generated under. Any price or availability would differ by location, and Amazon's returns and shipping terms are marketplace-specific. Nothing location-specific is published.
flags.action: Confirm in Associates Central which marketplace the Associates account and links belong to, and say which marketplace the site should target.

flags.title: 'Sponsored' label above the also-viewed carousel: P3 seen, P1 not seen on the latest read
flags.detail: On the 2026-11-14 read, the 'Sponsored' label appears above the also-viewed carousel on P3. On the same date it did not appear on P1 (an earlier read had shown it), and it does not appear on P2 in either read. Competitor ASINs from a labelled carousel may be paid placements. The P1 status is therefore unresolved.
flags.action: Treat the P3 competitor list as possibly sponsored. Re-check the P1 label in a signed-out browser before relying on either.

flags.title: Verification method may conflict with Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use licence excludes collecting and using product listings, descriptions or prices, and excludes data mining and robots. The Associates IP License §1 also excludes data mining, robots and similar extraction tools. The verification reads in the original pass and in the 2026-11-14 integration pass both used an automated retrieval tool on Amazon pages. The site keeps only identifiers, brand, category and a few specification fields, and does not publish prices or ratings. Scaling this approach (for example, automated product research) would need legal review.
flags.action: Review with counsel before any automated product research. Prefer PA-API / Creators API data or manual entry.

flags.title: AI content automation is restricted by Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use bar using AI-generated content from Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or machine learning models. The Associates IP License §1 bars using Program Content to develop or improve large language or multimodal models, machine learning models or related technology, and Participation Requirements §5 bars using Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models without written approval. The planned AI article generation has therefore NOT been built. It must be reviewed before it is connected to any Amazon-derived data.
flags.action: Decide the data sources for AI-generated articles and get a compliance review before automation.

flags.title: GitHub Pages source is main '/' (root redirect to docs/), not main '/docs'
flags.detail: The Pages API checked on 2026-11-14 reports build_type 'legacy' with source branch main, path '/'. A change to main '/docs' was attempted earlier and returned HTTP 403, so it was not made. A root index.html redirects to docs/index.html and a root .nojekyll is present, so the public URL serves the site. The earlier prior-session workflow ('Deploy static site to GitHub Pages') that failed before creating jobs was replaced by 'Site checks' (checks only). Later runs on main (Site checks 43584048548 and Pages deployment 43584048157) succeeded.
flags.action: In Settings, Pages: keep main '/' (the redirect works) or set main '/docs'. Confirm the public URL after each change.

flags.title: Prior prototype records superseded
flags.detail: The prototype pages from earlier sessions (root index.html, products.html, insights.html, flagged.html) held blank product records and an unverified status. They are replaced by the verified records in this site (git history keeps them).
flags.action: None.

flags.title: Trend, popularity and conversion signals are unverified
flags.detail: The product pages show Amazon badges (for example 'Amazon's Choice' and 'bought in past month') and rank-like signals. These are not published, because reuse of Amazon-displayed sales and review metrics was not confirmed (F-02). No official source provides verified trend or conversion data for these products, so trend and conversion fields are blank.
flags.action: Provide an official data source (for example, PA-API) or accept blank fields.

flags.title: Creators API / PA API license only partly reviewed
flags.detail: In the 2026-11-14 pass, the Associates Program IP License and Usage Requirements §1 (limited license, no data mining, no LLM or machine-learning use) and §2(a)-(f) were read. The rest of §2, the Specifications and the Creators API / PA API terms were not reviewed in full. No API integration is claimed.
flags.action: Read the full IP License and API Specifications before any API work.

flags.title: P2 listing gives two different cooking-function counts
flags.detail: The P2 listing subtitle says '24 cooking functions', and the 'About this item' bullets say '25 COOKING PRE-SETS'. Neither count is used on the site, but a comparison should not repeat either one until the manufacturer's specification is read.
flags.action: Confirm the count from the manufacturer's specification before using it.

flags.title: Amazon links on the site carry no Associates tag
flags.detail: Participation Requirements §2(b) requires the Associates ID (tag) as a URL parameter in each link from the site to an Amazon site. The source links (amazon.com/dp/ASIN) and the competitor links on this site are plain URLs with no tag. The user's short links also show no tag (F-03). No Associates ID was supplied, so no tag was added. A tag must not be guessed or invented.
flags.action: Supply your Associates ID (tag) so Special Links can be built, or confirm that untagged verification-only source links are acceptable.

flags.title: Competitor carousels change between page loads; some labels blank
flags.detail: The also-viewed carousel on P1 changed between reads on 2026-11-14: positions 2 and 3 were B0FZF445YL and B08DL8WH9V, not the stored B0CNSB81V6 and B0BYKGN61Q. The stored ASINs therefore describe the earlier snapshot only. The label for B0CNSB81V6 was not seen on the 2026-11-14 read and is left blank, not inferred.
flags.action: Decide whether the site should show one snapshot (dated) or none. Do not treat the list as a stable competitor set.

flags.title: Planned automation (research, AI articles, click tracking) conflicts with Participation Requirements 2(b), 3(s), 3(t) and 5
flags.detail: The brief asks for automated product research, AI article generation, publishing and click or conversion tracking. Participation 2(b) allows prices and availability only when Amazon serves the link or via Creators/PA API. Participation 3(s) forbids artificially generated clicks or impressions, including by robot or software. Participation 3(t) forbids showing reviews or star ratings unless obtained through Creators/PA API. Participation 5 forbids using Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models without express prior written approval. No PA-API or Creators API credentials, Associates tag or analytics access exist in this environment, so these features are not built and no values were simulated.
flags.action: Owner decision: obtain Associates and PA-API access, and written approval where required, before any automation is connected.
